_comment: Safety baseline for autonomous Conductor runs in this work_dir. The Conductor opens SDK sessions with settingSources:['project'] and cwd=this directory, so ONLY this file and settings.local.json are loaded — the baseline in claude_code/DEV/full_stack_sm/.claude/settings.json is never seen from here. Without this file, runs had no deny list and no PreToolUse guard at all. Allow rules stay in settings.local.json (untouched); deliberately no 'ask' array here, because a headless session cannot answer a prompt — irreversible actions are gated by the Conductor's ASK_PATTERNS over Telegram instead.
